services.title: Our services
services.subtitle: Complete support, from orientation all the way to your visa.

orientation.title: Orientation and profile assessment
items: Review of your academic and school background.
Verification of diplomas, grades and eligibility.
Identification of accessible programs and levels.
Language proficiency assessment.
Advice on your chances and application hurdles, with no guarantee of selection.
Development of a personalized application strategy.

bourses.title: Scholarship research and selection
items: Search for government, provincial and university scholarships.
Identification of universities matching your profile.
Search for programs taught in Chinese or English.
Verification of admission requirements and deadlines.
Comparison of full and partial scholarships.

dossier.title: Application file preparation and optimization
items: Creation or improvement of your academic CV.
Preparation of your study or research proposal.
Verification of diplomas, transcripts and translations.
Organization and review of administrative documents.
Preparation for required language or admission tests.

candidatures.title: Application management and tracking
items: Document review before submission.
Tracking of deadlines and additional requests.
Tracking of admission and scholarship results.
Support in case of rejection: analysis of identifiable causes.
Support in case of rejection: preparation of a new application.

trust.title: What we guarantee you, with full transparency
trust.admission: we only submit complete, verified application files. No one can honestly promise you guaranteed admission, and we won't either.
trust.scholarship: we prepare your application to maximize your chances, but the award depends on criteria we do not control: academic results, interview, number of available places, university choice.
trust.visa: we help you build a complete, solid file; the final decision belongs to the consular authorities.
